text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: L1 prompts · framework versus web harness

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: FW Our framework OH Opus 4.7 high OM Opus 4.7 max FM Fable 5.1 medium FX Fable 5.1 max
P No plot anywhere in saved history
H Plot only in history, not the answer

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Web bars exclude waiting between turns and use the displayed conversation branch. Output flags inspect the entire saved history.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Solver-running web commands may include inseparable rendering/startup; those commands are excluded. Bar heights are timing estimates, not quality scores.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Each stack sums to the bar total. Missing exports are shown as —, not zero-time runs.
